phases.name: Foundational strength
phases.focus: Build movement quality and establish safe loading patterns for core and spine

phases.name: Progressive resistance
phases.focus: Increase loading with emphasis on posterior chain and rib-to-pelvis stability

phases.name: Strength accumulation
phases.focus: Improve total-body strength with controlled progression and safe spinal loading

non_negotiables: No heavy spinal loading or loaded spinal flexion

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week General Strength with spinal safety"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "General strength with spinal safety"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundational strength" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY upper training 45m "Foundational upper":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75s
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75s
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
      DAY lower training 45m "Foundational lower":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6.5 rest 90s
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75s
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45s
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY hinge/accessory training 45m "Foundational hinge/accessory":
        warmup:
          hip_circles 1m
          cat_cow 1m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75s
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x12 (anti-rotation) rest 60s
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 1m
          hip_stretch 1m
      DAY conditioning training 30m "Foundational conditioning":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main steady_state:
          rower 15m moderate
        cooldown:
          deep_breathing 2m
  END_PHASE
  PHASE "Progressive resistance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY upper training 45m "Progressive upper":
        warmup:
          band_external_rot 1m
          thoracic_mrotation 1m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120s
          row_machine 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY lower training 45m "Progressive lower":
        warmup:
          bodyweight_squat 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90s
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY hinge/accessory training 45m "Progressive hinge/accessory":
        warmup:
          glute_activation 1m
          demonstrated_bracing 1m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120s
          good_morning_modified 3x8 rpe 6.5 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75s
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 1m
          thoracic_extension 1m
      DAY conditioning training 30m "Progressive conditioning":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 2m
        main steady_state:
          cycling 15m moderate
        cooldown:
          breathing 2m
  END_PHASE
  PHASE "Strength accumulation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY upper training 50m "Strength accumulation upper":
        warmup:
          band pull-aparts 1m
          external_rotation 1m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150s
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120s
          overhead_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120s
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          triceps_stretch 1m
      DAY lower training 50m "Strength accumulation lower":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_openers 1m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150s
          sumo_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75s
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
      DAY hinge/accessory training 50m "Strength hinge/accessory":
        warmup:
          glute_activation 1m
          plank_bracing 1m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120s
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75s
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY conditioning training 30m "Strength conditioning":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 2m
        main interval:
          rower 8x1min hard/1min easy
        cooldown:
          breathing 3m
  END_PHASE
